members.name: HashLocation
members.about: Parsed representation of a hash URL: the path component and a URLSearchParams for the query string following `?`.

members.name: parseHash
members.about: Parses a raw hash string (e.g. `#/apps/sports?palette=bold`) into a HashLocation with a normalised path and a URLSearchParams; returns an empty location for a blank or bare `#`.

members.name: replaceParams

members.name: pathSegments

files.name: matchup.ts

members.name: StatKey
members.about: The five non-scoring box-score stats the matchup model prices: rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, and turnovers.

members.name: StatDef
members.about: Metadata for one modelled stat: its key, display labels, the Team field it reads, its possession weight, and the human-readable rationale shown in the pricing panel.

members.name: STAT_DEFS
members.about: Ordered array of the five StatDef descriptors; drives both the pricing panel UI and every loop that computes contributions across the modelled stats.

members.name: LEAGUE_PPP
members.about: League points per possession, computed from the teams: the average of each team's `pointsFor / possessionsPerGame`.

members.name: round2
members.about: Rounds a number to two decimal places; used to store DEFAULT_RATES as tidy display-friendly values.

members.name: DEFAULT_RATES
members.about: Data-derived default rate for each stat: `LEAGUE_PPP × possessionWeight`.

members.name: LEAGUE_AVERAGES
members.about: League-average per-game value for every modelled stat.

members.name: LEAGUE_BASELINE_POINTS
members.about: League-average points scored per game — the baseline a projection builds on.

members.name: StatContribution
members.about: One team's contribution from a single stat: the raw value, league average, delta, the rate used, and both relative-points and absolute-points framings — the full per-cell data the matchup views render.

members.name: TeamMatchup
members.about: One team's full matchup analysis: its StatContribution array, the net hidden-points sum versus a league-average opponent, and the resulting projected score.

members.name: TOV_BASELINE
members.about: Highest turnover rate across all teams, used as the reference ceiling so "ball security" (TOV absolute points) reads as bigger-is-better rather than smaller-is-better.

members.name: buildContribution
members.about: Computes one StatContribution for a (team, stat, rate) triple: pulls the team's per-game value, subtracts the league average, multiplies by rate for relative points, and applies the TOV-inversion for absolute points.

members.name: analyzeTeam
members.about: Builds a TeamMatchup for one team given a rate map — computes each stat's contribution, sums the net relative points, and projects a score above the league baseline.

members.name: StatEdge
members.about: Head-to-head advantage for one stat: team A's and B's relative points plus the signed edge (A minus B), used to populate the per-row winner indicators in the matchup comparison table.

members.name: MatchupAnalysis
members.about: Complete two-team matchup result returned by analyzeMatchup: both TeamMatchup objects, per-stat StatEdge array, total net edge, baseline, the rate map used, and normalisation maxima for bar-chart scaling.

members.name: analyzeMatchup
members.about: Build the full two-team analysis used by every view on the matchup screen.

members.name: formatPoints
members.about: "+2.3" / "-1.4" / "0.0" — signed, one decimal, for point values.

members.name: formatValue
members.about: Unsigned one-decimal, for raw stat values.

members.name: formatRate
members.about: Formats a number as a fixed two-decimal rate string, e.g. 0.35 or -1.06.

files.about: Sortable player roster page for all teams, filterable by position (PG/SG/SF/PF/C) via a Segmented pill, backed by a Table with per-column sort and PPG descending by default.

files.name: Standings.tsx

members.name: Standings
members.about: Renders one sortable `Table` per conference using `getStandings`; GB is computed relative to the conference leader; team names render as `TeamChip` links to TeamDetail.

files.about: Conference standings page showing Eastern and Western conferences as separate sortable tables with W, L, PCT, GB, PF, PA, L10, and STRK columns, backed by `getStandings` sorted by winning percentage.

files.name: TeamDetail.tsx

members.name: TeamDetailProps
members.about: Props for TeamDetail — the URL slug string resolved via `getTeamBySlug`.

members.name: TeamDetail

members.name: StatCell
members.about: Single stat cell in the Team stats tab: a small label above a larger value; returns null for an empty label so the grid can be padded with blank entries.

files.about: Team profile page with a coloured-border header (record, conference, coach, arena) and three Tabs: Roster (sortable player table linking to PlayerDetail), Schedule (all games with W/L result and box-score links), and Team stats (PF, PA, net, streaks).

files.name: Teams.tsx

members.name: ConfFilter
members.about: Union of the three conference filter options on the Teams page: show all teams, or narrow to Eastern or Western Conference only.

members.name: Teams
members.about: Filters TEAMS by the chosen conference, renders each as a gradient-banner Card with city, division, W-L record, and current streak; shows an EmptyState when no teams match.

files.about: Team browser page showing all 10 teams as Card tiles with a gradient banner, record, and streak, filterable by conference (All / East / West) via a Segmented pill control; each card links to TeamDetail.

files.name: routes.ts

members.name: SPORTS_BASE
members.about: Root path segment shared by every sports-app URL, e.g. "/apps/sports".

members.name: sportsRoutes
members.about: Typed URL-builder functions for every sports route; every Link in the app calls one of these so path shapes can change in a single place.

members.name: SportsRoute
members.about: Discriminated union of every reachable sports route, consumed by pages and shells to render the correct content without string comparisons.

members.name: matchSportsRoute
members.about: Parses the segments AFTER `apps/sports` and returns a discriminated route.

files.about: Route definitions and URL helpers for the sports app — SPORTS_BASE prefix, sportsRoutes builders, the SportsRoute discriminated union, and the matchSportsRoute parser.

files.name: bento.tsx

members.name: WidgetId
members.about: Union of the five dashboard widget identifiers available in the bento layout.

members.name: ALL_WIDGETS
members.about: Canonical widget order used as the default and as the reset target.

members.name: WIDGET_LABELS
members.about: Human-readable display names for each widget, shown in tile headers and the hidden-widgets tray.

members.name: parseBento
members.about: Parses the `?bento=` param (comma-joined WidgetIds) into an ordered visible list, filtering invalid tokens and falling back to ALL_WIDGETS when the result is empty.

members.name: serializeBento
members.about: Serialises a WidgetId array to a comma-joined string for `?bento=`, returning undefined when it matches the default order so clean URLs are preserved.

members.name: liveGame
members.about: Returns the first live game in GAMES, or undefined if none are currently in progress.

members.name: topTeam
members.about: Returns the team with the best winning percentage across both conferences — used as the Spotlight widget's featured team.

members.name: widgetRoute
members.about: Maps a WidgetId to the canonical deep-link route for "Open full page" — live goes to the live game or the schedule, spotlight goes to the top team or teams list.

members.name: LiveWidget
members.about: Compact live-scoreboard widget: shows a pulsing indicator, clock string, and one row per team with abbreviation badge and current score; shows an empty message when no game is live.

members.name: LeadersWidget
members.about: Compact PPG leaders widget: ordered list of the top-5 scorers with rank, abbreviated first name, last name, and PPG value.

members.name: StandingsWidget
members.about: Compact standings widget: two side-by-side columns (East / West) each showing the top-3 teams with rank, abbreviation badge, and W-L record.

members.name: ScheduleWidget
members.about: Compact schedule widget: lists the next four upcoming (scheduled) games with date and away @ home abbreviation matchup.

members.name: SpotlightWidget
members.about: Compact team spotlight widget: shows the best-record team's crest, city/name, conference, W-L record, last-10, and streak.

members.name: widgetBody
members.about: Switches on WidgetId and returns the appropriate compact widget component for rendering inside a bento tile.

members.name: widgetModal
members.about: Switches on WidgetId and returns the full page component to render inside the expanded Modal when a tile is clicked.

members.name: BentoNav
members.about: Horizontal nav bar for the bento shell, rendering each NavItem as a styled link with active-state highlighting.

members.name: BentoShell
members.about: Dashboard shell with a user-customisable widget grid on the Home route and a standard page layout on every other route; widget visibility and order persist in the `?bento=` URL param so the configuration survives navigation.

files.about: BentoShell — configurable dashboard shell that replaces the Home page with a reorderable grid of five sports widgets (live scoreboard, stat leaders, standings, schedule, team spotlight), each expandable into a modal; on other routes renders the standard page.

files.name: chat.tsx

members.name: Card
members.about: Discriminated union of the six inline entity card variants the chat bot can emit: team, player, game, leaderboard, standings, and player comparison.

members.name: Message
members.about: One entry in the chat log: a numeric id, sender role (user/bot), the text bubble, optional entity cards, and optional follow-up chip prompts.

members.name: SUGGESTIONS
members.about: Pre-seeded quick-prompt strings shown as chips on first load and as follow-up suggestions after bot responses.

members.name: STAT_LABELS
members.about: Human-readable labels for each StatKey used in bot response text (e.g. "points per game" for ppg).

members.name: SEQ
members.about: Monotonically-increasing message id counter; incremented every time answer() or the user push creates a new Message so each item has a stable React key.

members.name: LOG
members.about: Module-level scrollback log holding all messages for the current page session; persists across ChatShell remounts because it lives outside React state.

members.name: classifyStat
members.about: Regex-based classifier that maps free-text query words (e.g. "scoring", "ppg", "rebound") to a StatKey, returning null when no stat keyword is recognised.

members.name: findTeam
members.about: Searches the TEAMS array for any team whose name, city, or abbreviation appears in the lowercased query text, returning the first match or undefined.

members.name: findPlayers
members.about: Scans PLAYERS for anyone whose full name or last name appears in the query text, returning up to `max` unique matches in array order.

members.name: answer
members.about: Rule-based intent classifier that converts a user query string into a bot Message with text, entity cards, and follow-up chip prompts; checks for tonight/live/standings/leaders/compare/team/player intents in priority order.

members.name: TeamCardView
members.about: Inline entity card for a team rendered inside a bot message; shows abbreviation mark, full name, conference, record, streak, and arena in a coloured bordered link row.

members.name: PlayerCardView
members.about: Inline entity card for a player rendered inside a bot message; shows initials mark in team colour, full name, position, jersey, team abbreviation, and PPG in a bordered link row.

members.name: GameCardView
members.about: Inline entity card for a game rendered inside a bot message; shows status/quarter, two team rows with colour marks and conditional scores, linking to the game detail page.

members.name: LeaderboardView
members.about: Ranked list card showing up to five players with their rank number, name, and the formatted stat value; each row links to the player's detail page.

members.name: StandingsView
members.about: Conference standings card showing ranked team rows with colour marks, record, and win percentage; each row links to the team detail page.

members.name: ComparisonView
members.about: Side-by-side stat table for two or more players with PPG/RPG/APG/SPG/BPG rows; the highest value in each row gets the `is-best` CSS class for visual emphasis.

members.name: CardView
members.about: Dispatcher that selects the correct card view component (TeamCardView, PlayerCardView, GameCardView, LeaderboardView, StandingsView, or ComparisonView) based on the Card discriminant.

members.name: MessageView
members.about: Renders a single chat message bubble (user or bot) with optional entity cards below the text and optional follow-up chip buttons that call onChip when clicked.

members.name: ChatSurface
members.about: Full chat interface including the scrollable message log, quick-chip bar, text input, send button, and reset button; appends to the module-level LOG on submit and chip clicks, then forces a re-render.

members.name: ChatNav
members.about: Primary navigation bar rendered in the ChatShell header; links to all sports sections with `is-active` on the current route.

members.name: ChatShell
members.about: Conversational shell that renders the chat surface on the Home route and a back-link + detail page on every other route; the shared module-level LOG survives layout switches so the thread is never lost.

files.about: ChatShell — conversational shell that replaces the Home page with a keyword-driven chat interface; responses render inline entity cards (team, player, game, leaderboard, standings, side-by-side comparison) with click-through routing, and the scrollback log persists for the session across remounts.

files.name: court.tsx

members.name: Hotspot
members.about: Definition for a single interactive puck on the court SVG: its centre coordinates, button label, secondary hint text, and the route it navigates to.

members.name: HOTSPOTS
members.about: Six hotspot puck definitions placed at basketball-meaningful positions on the court: two in the paint (hoop and free-throw), two on the wings (East/West standings), one at the arc (Shooters), and one at the tip-off circle.

members.name: CourtMap
members.about: Renders a 500×500 SVG half-court with floor, key, free-throw circle, 3-pt arc, backboard, hoop, and the six HOTSPOTS as keyboard-accessible puck groups; placed on the Home route by CourtShell.

members.name: CourtNav
members.about: Primary navigation bar rendered in the CourtShell header; links to all sports sections with `is-active` on the current route.

members.name: CourtShell
members.about: Shell that shows an SVG court with labelled hotspot pucks on the Home route and renders the standard page on all other routes; hotspots are keyboard-accessible (Enter/Space triggers navigate).

files.about: CourtShell — spatial navigation shell that replaces the Home page with an interactive SVG basketball court; hotspot pucks positioned around the key, arc, and half-court navigate to players, standings, and games on click or keyboard activation.

files.name: deck.tsx

members.name: Stack
members.about: Union of the three card stacks the deck can show: teams alphabetically, players by PPG, games by date.

members.name: STACKS
members.about: Ordered metadata for each stack: its id, button label, and pluralised noun used in empty-state messages.

members.name: parseDeck
members.about: Parses the `?deck=<stack>.<index>` URL param into a typed stack id and a non-negative integer index, defaulting to `teams` at 0 when the param is absent or malformed.

members.name: serializeDeck
members.about: Serialises stack and card index back to the `?deck=` string, returning undefined (omit the param) when the values match the canonical default so the URL stays clean before the user interacts.

members.name: TEAMS_SORTED
members.about: All teams sorted alphabetically by city — the traversal order for the Teams card stack.

members.name: PLAYERS_SORTED
members.about: All players sorted by PPG descending — the traversal order for the Players card stack.

members.name: GAMES_SORTED
members.about: All games sorted by date descending (most recent first) — the traversal order for the Games card stack.

members.name: stackLength
members.about: Returns the total number of cards in the given stack by consulting the matching sorted array.

members.name: clampIndex
members.about: Clamps an arbitrary index into the valid range [0, stackLength − 1], returning 0 for an empty stack.

members.name: TeamCard
members.about: Full-bleed card for a single team showing the crest, conference/division kicker, record stats, the top-3 scorers by PPG, and the team's most recent final game; placed in the Teams stack by CardFor.

members.name: PlayerCard
members.about: Full-bleed card for a single player showing initials crest in team colour, jersey/position kicker, six per-game stat tiles, and a link to the full player page; placed in the Players stack by CardFor.

members.name: GameCard
members.about: Full-bleed card for a single game showing status/quarter kicker, a two-row matchup block with scores, and up to three top-performer rows; placed in the Games stack by CardFor.

members.name: RecentGameRow
members.about: Compact one-row summary of a single game (away abbreviation, scores, home abbreviation, and formatted date) rendered as a link inside TeamCard's "Most recent final" section.

members.name: Stat
members.about: Single label/value tile used inside card stat grids; renders a small kicker label above a bold numeric value.

members.name: CardFor
members.about: Dispatcher that picks the correct card component (TeamCard, PlayerCard, or GameCard) for the current stack and index, returning null when the index falls out of range.

members.name: DeckNav
members.about: Primary navigation bar rendered in the DeckShell header; links to all sports sections, marking the active route with `is-active`.

members.name: DeckProps
members.about: Props for DeckSurface: the current stack id and card index, plus callbacks to change either when the user navigates.

members.name: DeckSurface
members.about: Interactive swipe/keyboard surface that renders the stack-selector tab bar, the active card (via CardFor), prev/next arrow controls, and touch-swipe handlers; keyboard ←/→ flips cards, ↑/↓ cycles stacks.

members.name: DeckBreadcrumb
members.about: Breadcrumb bar shown on detail routes with a "← Back to deck" link and a position indicator (e.g. "Players · 3 of 12") so the user knows which card they left before navigating away.

members.name: DeckShell
members.about: Shell that mounts DeckSurface (swipeable cards across teams / players / games stacks) on the Home route and a breadcrumb + detail page on other routes; stack and card index are kept in the `?deck=` URL param.

files.about: DeckShell — card-swipe shell that replaces the Home page with three full-bleed stacks (teams alphabetically, players by PPG, games by date); arrow keys, touch swipes, and on-screen controls flip cards and switch stacks, with position persisted in `?deck=<stack>.<index>`.

files.name: feed.tsx

members.name: EntryKind
members.about: The four visual kinds of feed card: live game, completed final, upcoming scheduled game, and a stat-leader highlight.

members.name: StatusFilter
members.about: Status filter values for the feed chip strip: all games, live-only, finals-only, or upcoming-only.

members.name: ConferenceFilter
members.about: Conference filter values for the feed: show all teams, East only, or West only.

members.name: GameEntry
members.about: Feed entry representing a game; carries pre-resolved home/away Team objects, a sort timestamp that encodes both priority and date, and the game's kind category.

members.name: LeaderEntry
members.about: Feed entry representing a season stat leader; carries the player, their team, a human-readable stat label (e.g. "PPG leader"), and the formatted value.

members.name: FeedEntry
members.about: Discriminated union of the two concrete feed entry types, used by applyFilters and the GameRow/LeaderRow dispatch in FeedStream.

members.name: STATUS_FILTERS
members.about: Ordered chip options for the status filter strip; the `all` option resets the filter and re-shows leader cards.

members.name: CONFERENCE_FILTERS
members.about: Ordered chip options for the conference filter strip; selecting East or West hides games and leaders from the other conference.

members.name: dateOrdinal
members.about: Converts a "YYYY-MM-DD" date string to a UTC millisecond timestamp used for sort comparisons in buildEntries.

members.name: buildEntries
members.about: Builds the full unsorted feed by classifying every game into a priority bucket and appending one leader card each for PPG, RPG, and APG; returns entries sorted by descending sortTs so live games always appear first.

members.name: FilterState
members.about: Snapshot of all three active filter dimensions held in FeedShell state; passed to applyFilters on every render.

members.name: applyFilters
members.about: Filters a FeedEntry array against all three filter dimensions; leader cards are hidden whenever any narrowing filter is active, since they represent league-wide highlights rather than per-team data.

members.name: statusBadgeLabel
members.about: Computes the human-readable badge text for a feed entry: for live games includes quarter and time-remaining, for finals/upcoming/leaders returns a fixed string.

members.name: GameRow
members.about: Card-style link for a single game entry showing status badge, date, two team rows with abbreviation swatches and conditional scores, and a top-performers footnote for finals; styled with a kind-specific CSS modifier.

members.name: LeaderRow
members.about: Card-style link for a stat-leader entry showing a coloured initials avatar, player name, position and team, and the formatted season stat value; navigates to the player's detail page.

members.name: FeedStream
members.about: Stateless list of feed entries with the status/conference/team filter controls above; builds the full entry list once via useMemo and delegates rendering to GameRow or LeaderRow per entry kind.

members.name: FeedNav
members.about: Primary navigation bar rendered in the FeedShell header; links to all sports sections with `is-active` on the current route.

members.name: FeedShell
members.about: Shell that renders FeedStream full-width on Home and as a left rail alongside props.children on detail routes; filter state lives in the shell so it survives the Home ↔ detail transition.

files.about: FeedShell — timeline-stream shell that replaces the Home page with a chronological feed of game and stat-leader cards (live first, then today's finals and upcoming, then the season leaders) with status, conference, and team filters; on detail routes the feed collapses to a persistent left rail beside the page.

files.name: graph.tsx

members.name: NodeKind
members.about: Union of the three node categories in the force-directed graph: teams, players, and games.

members.name: GraphNode
members.about: All data needed to render and interact with one node: its kind, display text, team colour, route link, radius, and computed x/y position.

members.name: GraphEdge
members.about: A directed connection between two node ids used to draw SVG lines and build the neighbour lookup for hover highlighting.

members.name: W
members.about: SVG viewport width in pixels for the force-directed graph canvas.

members.name: H
members.about: SVG viewport height in pixels for the force-directed graph canvas.

members.name: CX
members.about: Horizontal centre of the SVG viewport, used as the gravity anchor for the spring layout.

members.name: CY
members.about: Vertical centre of the SVG viewport, used as the gravity anchor for the spring layout.

members.name: NODE_RADIUS
members.about: Circle radius in pixels for each node kind: teams are largest (22), games medium (13), players smallest (11).

members.name: buildGraph
members.about: Constructs the initial node and edge lists: teams on an inner ring, players fanned around their team at a larger radius, games placed between their two home/away team nodes.

members.name: relax
members.about: Runs 120 iterations of a spring/repulsion simulation to spread overlapping nodes and pull connected pairs toward a rest distance of 88px; returns nodes with updated x/y positions.

members.name: LAYOUT_CACHE
members.about: Module-level cache for the relaxed node positions, edge list, and neighbour sets; null until first call to getLayout, then reused across remounts.

members.name: getLayout
members.about: Returns the cached layout (building and relaxing it on first call), including the neighbour map used for hover-highlight diffusion.

members.name: FILTER_CODES
members.about: Short single-character codes for each NodeKind used in the `?graph=` URL param (e.g. `t,p` means teams and players only).

members.name: ALL_KINDS
members.about: Canonical ordered list of all three node kinds, used for iteration order in filter parsing and chip rendering.

members.name: parseFilter
members.about: Parses the `?graph=` comma-joined code string into a Set of visible NodeKinds, returning all three kinds when the param is absent or would leave the canvas empty.

members.name: serializeFilter
members.about: Serialises a NodeKind Set back to the `?graph=` code string, returning undefined when all three kinds are visible so the URL stays clean.

members.name: GraphSurface
members.about: SVG graph canvas with filter chips; renders edges and node circles from the cached layout, dims non-neighbours on hover, and delegates click/keyboard to navigate; placed on the Home route by GraphShell.

members.name: GraphNav
members.about: Primary navigation bar rendered in the GraphShell header; links to all sports sections with `is-active` on the current route.

members.name: GraphShell
members.about: Shell that mounts the force-directed GraphSurface on the Home route and the standard page on all other routes; the visible node-kind set is persisted in `?graph=` as a compact comma-joined code string.

files.about: GraphShell — force-directed network shell that replaces the Home page with an SVG graph of teams (inner ring), players (outer fan), and games (between team pairs); hover highlights connected nodes, click navigates to the entity page, and filter chips show/hide node kinds; layout is computed once and cached.

files.name: magazine.tsx

members.name: Section
members.about: Label/id pair for each editorial section of the magazine home page, used by SectionNav to generate scroll-to buttons.

members.name: SECTIONS
members.about: Ordered list of the four editorial sections (Cover, Pull quote, Leaderboard, Inside the East) whose ids are also HTML element ids targeted by SectionNav.

members.name: gameOfTheNight
members.about: Picks the marquee game for the cover: returns the live game if one exists, otherwise today's highest-combined-record scheduled game, falling back to the most recent final.

members.name: statusKicker
members.about: Returns a capitalised kicker string for the magazine cover (e.g. "LIVE NOW · Q3" / "TONIGHT'S TIP-OFF · Jun 8" / "LATEST FINAL · Jun 7") based on game status.

members.name: gameLede
members.about: Generates a one-paragraph editorial lede for the marquee game: a "visiting" sentence for live, a preview sentence for scheduled, or a margin/winner recap sentence for finals.

members.name: MagazineCover
members.about: Magazine front-cover section showing masthead, status kicker, "Game of the Night" headline, a two-team matchup block with crests/scores, an editorial lede, and a "Read the box score" link; placed first on the Home route.

members.name: PullQuote
members.about: Editorial pull-quote section featuring the league's PPG leader: displays the stat value large, a fixed attributed quote, and linked player/team names; placed after MagazineCover.

members.name: Leaderboard
members.about: Three-column "By the Numbers" section showing the top-5 for scoring, rebounding, and playmaking (PPG/RPG/APG) as ranked linked lists; placed after PullQuote on the Home route.

members.name: InsideTheEast
members.about: Editorial feature section for the Eastern Conference: a prose blurb driven by the top two standings entries, beside a sidebar of the East top-5 with coloured marks and records; placed last on the Home route.

members.name: MagazineNav
members.about: Primary navigation bar rendered in the MagazineShell header; links to all sports sections with `is-active` on the current route.

members.name: SectionNav
members.about: In-page "jump to section" nav rendered above the magazine cover; each button scrolls to the matching `id` element using scrollIntoView without touching the hash router.

members.name: MagazineShell
members.about: Shell that renders a long-scroll editorial cover on the Home route and a single-column article layout on other routes; the in-page section nav scrolls to anchors without clobbering the hash router.

files.about: MagazineShell — editorial-layout shell that replaces the Home page with a print-magazine cover: a marquee game (live → tonight's best scheduled → latest final), a PPG pull-quote, a three-column leaderboard, and an "Inside the East" feature with inline standings; on other routes renders the standard page at a wider type scale.

files.name: palette.tsx

members.name: Kind
members.about: Union of the four result categories the palette can return: top-level sections, teams, players, and games.

members.name: PaletteResult
members.about: A single search result row: a stable key, the result category, the primary label, secondary meta text, and the route to navigate on selection.

members.name: SECTIONS
members.about: Pre-built section results for Home, Teams, Players, Games, and Standings; returned as the full result list when the query is empty.

members.name: searchAll
members.about: Runs a case-insensitive substring search across sections, teams, players, and games, returning up to 20 PaletteResult rows in priority order (sections first, then teams, players, games).

members.name: PaletteShell
members.about: Shell that renders a command-palette search box above the main content area on every route; unlike other shells it does not replace the Home page — it augments all pages with the palette affordance.

files.about: PaletteShell — command-palette shell that adds a persistent full-width search bar above every page; the bar searches sections, teams, players, and games simultaneously, is focusable with `/` or ⌘K from anywhere, and navigates on Enter or row click.

files.name: tabs.tsx

members.name: HOME_KEY
members.about: Sentinel string used as the tab key for the sports home route, stored in `?tabs=` in place of the full path suffix.

members.name: pathToKey
members.about: Converts a full router path to the shorthand stored in `?tabs=` (strips SPORTS_BASE prefix; empty suffix becomes HOME_KEY).

members.name: keyToPath
members.about: Converts a tab key back to a navigable router path by prepending SPORTS_BASE, or returning the home route for HOME_KEY.

members.name: labelForKey
members.about: Derives a human-readable tab label from a raw tab key by parsing it back to a SportsRoute and delegating to labelForRoute.

members.name: labelForRoute
members.about: Maps a typed SportsRoute to a short display string for the tab strip (e.g. team name, "J. Smith" for a player, "BOS @ NYK" for a game); returns the raw fallback string for unrecognised route kinds.

members.name: TabsNavMenu
members.about: Secondary navigation menu rendered below the tab strip; links to all sports sections so the user can open any section as a new tab.

members.name: TabsShell
members.about: Shell that renders a tab strip above a standard-page main area; opening a new route appends it to the strip, closing a tab focuses the neighbour and removes it from the `?tabs=` param, and the "+" button opens a fresh Home tab.

files.about: TabsShell — browser-tabs shell that maintains a persistent strip of open pages; every navigation appends the destination to the strip if not already there, tabs are closeable, and the full tab list is serialised into `?tabs=` so the workspace survives a refresh.

files.name: triptych.tsx

members.name: Section
members.about: Union of the three browseable sections in col-1 of the triptych: teams, players, and games.

members.name: SECTIONS
members.about: Ordered metadata for the three section tabs rendered in col-1's section switcher.

members.name: sectionFromRoute
members.about: Infers which triptych section (teams/players/games) best matches a given route, defaulting to teams for home and list routes.

members.name: entityIdFromRoute
members.about: Extracts the entity id (team id, player id, or game id) implied by the current route so col-1 and col-2 can pre-select the matching item when navigating via a deep link.

members.name: ListItem
members.about: Normalised row shape for the col-1 scrollable list: entity id, display label, secondary meta string, and optional colour swatch.

members.name: listForSection
members.about: Builds the col-1 list for a given section: teams sorted alphabetically by city, players sorted by PPG descending, games sorted by date descending.

members.name: isInSection
members.about: Returns true if the given entity id belongs to the specified section's data set, used to validate selectedId after a section switch.

members.name: Stats
members.about: Grid of label/value stat tiles used inside TeamSummary and PlayerSummary panels in col-2.

members.name: SubLink
members.about: Shape for a sub-list row in col-2 summary panels: a unique key, a route destination, and label/meta ReactNodes.

members.name: SubList
members.about: Titled linked list used inside summary panels (col-2) to show sub-entities such as top scorers under a TeamSummary or recent games under a PlayerSummary.

members.name: SummaryHead
members.about: Header block shared by all three summary types (team/player/game) in col-2; renders an optional coloured crest, a kicker line, the entity name, and a meta line with an optional accent border.

members.name: gameLink
members.about: Converts a Game into a SubLink (away@home label + formatted date) for use in TeamSummary and PlayerSummary sub-lists; returns null if either team is missing.

members.name: TeamSummary
members.about: Col-2 panel for a selected team showing crest/header, six record stats, a top-5 scorers sub-list, a recent-games sub-list, and a link to open the full team page in col-3.

members.name: PlayerSummary

members.about: A chord diagram node — a unique id, display label, and optional explicit intent override (otherwise assigned by index from the intent rotation).

members.name: ChordLink
members.about: A flow link between two node ids with a mandatory numeric value that determines arc sub-span and ribbon area; `highlight` flags the link for accent coloring on the 'highlighted' variant.

members.name: ChordDiagramProps

members.name: INTENTS
members.about: Rotation of the six contract intents used to assign distinct colors to nodes by index when no explicit intent is provided.

members.name: ARC_GAP
members.about: Radians of dead space inserted between consecutive node arc segments to visually separate them on the circle.

members.name: ARC_W
members.about: Pixel width of each node's arc band (the filled ring segment), controlling the visual thickness of the ring.

members.name: polar
members.about: Converts polar coordinates (center cx/cy, radius r, angle a in radians) to Cartesian {x, y}, used to compute arc and ribbon path endpoints.

members.name: arcPath
members.about: Builds an SVG path for a donut-ring arc segment between angles `a0` and `a1`, bounded by inner radius `rIn` and outer radius `rOut`; used to draw each node's colored band on the ring.

members.name: ribbonPath
members.about: Builds an SVG path for a filled ribbon connecting arc sub-span [a0, a1] on one node to sub-span [b0, b1] on another, using two arc segments on the ring and quadratic Bézier curves through the center to fill the enclosed shape.

members.name: ChordDiagram
members.about: Allocates each node a proportional arc on a circle based on its total flow, then subdivides each arc into per-link sub-spans and draws a `ribbonPath` cubic Bézier between matching sub-spans; arc labels are positioned radially outside each arc midpoint.

files.about: SVG chord diagram that arranges nodes as arcs on a circle and draws bi-directional ribbon paths between them, with simple, value-weighted opacity, and highlighted accent variants.

files.name: CirclePack.tsx

members.name: CirclePackVariant
members.about: Display mode — 'flat' fills only leaf circles (parents shown as outlines), 'nested' fills every depth level, 'labeled' fills all levels and overlays text labels on circles larger than 14px radius.

members.name: CirclePackIntent
members.about: Semantic color token applied to a node's circle fill, inherited by children unless overridden, drawn from the six contract intents.

members.name: CirclePackNode
members.about: A tree node with a unique id, display label, optional numeric value (leaf size), optional explicit intent, and optional children for recursive nesting.

members.name: CirclePackProps
members.about: Props for CirclePack — supplies the root tree node, variant, and SVG dimensions; the entire hierarchy is packed from a single `root`.

members.name: INTENTS
members.about: Rotation of the six contract intents used to assign distinct colors to root-level nodes when no explicit intent is provided; propagated down to children as the parent intent.

members.name: Placed
members.about: A fully resolved circle placement — the original tree node, its nesting depth, center coordinates, radius, and resolved intent color, output by `packTree` for direct rendering.

members.name: sumValue
members.about: Recursively sums the `value` fields of all leaf descendants of `n`, returning the subtree's total weight; used to size parent circles proportionally in `packChildren`.

members.name: packChildren
members.about: Places `children` inside a bounding circle of radius `R` using a deterministic front-chain algorithm: scales each child's radius so the summed area fills 75% of the parent, places the first two on the x-axis, then iterates — placing each new circle tangent to the best adjacent pair in the convex-envelope chain.

members.name: packTree
members.about: Recursively visits every node in the tree, calling `packChildren` for each branch to place children within their parent's circle, and collects all placed nodes as a flat `Placed[]` array for rendering.

members.name: CirclePack
members.about: Runs `packTree` to produce a flat `Placed[]` array of (x, y, r, intent, depth) via `packChildren`'s front-chain algorithm, then maps each entry to an SVG `<circle>`, coloring by intent and depth-relative tint level; 'labeled' adds centered `<text>` for circles with r > 14.

files.about: SVG circle-packing visualization that recursively packs a tree of nodes into nested or flat circles using a front-chain layout algorithm, with flat, nested, and labeled display variants.

members.name: DiffView

members.name: useControlsStyle
members.about: Shared user preference for the floating controls' style (Button FAB vs Hidden).

members.name: openControlsHelpText
members.about: Plain-English sentence describing how to open the floating preferences for a given style and tap gesture, plus the keyboard "Open preferences" button; reused by the page info popovers (OpenControlsHelp) and the Hidden-mode "?" badge (OpenControlsHint).

members.name: OpenControlsHelp
members.about: One-line "how to open preferences" note for a page's info/help popover, reading the live controls style and open-gesture so the help stays accurate whether the float is shown or hidden.

members.name: OpenControlsHint
members.about: A "?" badge shown beside a page's info button only when the floating preferences are Hidden; clicking it reveals a short popover explaining the tap gesture that opens them, keeping the controls discoverable with no float on screen.

members.name: Field
members.about: A single control field descriptor: key, label, short label, current value, options array, onChange callback, and an optional kind='palette' flag that substitutes PalettePicker for a generic select.

members.name: Position
members.about: An x/y pixel coordinate representing the floating container's top-left position within the viewport.

members.name: Props
members.about: Props for the DraggableControls root — the current controls style, a callback to change it, the array of control field descriptors to render, and an optional NavControls bundle that renders the cross-page nav as a collapsible section when the active layout is 'in-controls'.

members.name: POS_KEY
members.about: Returns the per-style localStorage key used to persist the floating container's position.

members.name: OPEN_KEY
members.about: Returns the per-style localStorage key used to persist the panel's open/closed state.

members.name: DEFAULTS
members.about: Factory-default pixel positions for each controls style when no saved position exists on a desktop viewport.

members.name: clamp
members.about: Clamps n to the inclusive [lo, hi] range; used to keep the draggable container within the viewport bounds.

members.name: defaultPos
members.about: Computes the initial position for a controls style, placing the button FAB in the bottom-right thumb zone on phone-sized viewports (≤640px wide or ≤480px tall).

members.name: loadPos
members.about: Reads the saved Position for a controls style from localStorage; falls back to defaultPos when absent or unparseable.

members.name: loadOpen
members.about: Reads the saved open/closed state for a controls style from localStorage; returns the fallback boolean when no stored value is found.

members.name: STYLE_OPTIONS
members.about: The two available controls-style options rendered by the StyleSwitcher radiogroup.

members.name: VerticalDir
members.about: Vertical half of the popover quadrant — 'up' means the panel opens upward from the anchor, 'down' means downward.

members.name: HorizontalDir
members.about: Horizontal half of the popover quadrant — 'left' means the panel extends leftward from the anchor, 'right' means rightward.

members.name: Quadrant
members.about: The four possible quadrants for the Button-variant panel, expressed as a vertical-horizontal direction pair.

members.name: pickQuadrant
members.about: Inspects the trigger's bounding rect and returns the quadrant with the most available viewport space, used to anchor the floating panel away from viewport edges.

members.name: useOverflowEdges
members.about: Hook that toggles data-overflow-top and data-overflow-bottom attributes on a scrollable panel element when content is hidden above or below the visible area, enabling CSS fade indicators.

members.name: DraggableControls
members.about: Root draggable container that handles pointer-based drag positioning, viewport clamping on resize/orientation-change, the tap-to-summon gesture, and localStorage persistence of position and open state; delegates rendering to ButtonVariant (which shows a FAB for 'button' or an invisible anchor for 'hidden').

members.name: VariantProps
members.about: Props passed down to ButtonVariant — the field list, the optional in-controls nav bundle, current-value summary strings, open state, drag event handlers, the active controls style, and the style-change callback.

members.name: StyleSwitcher
members.about: Radiogroup of two buttons (Button / Hidden) that lets the user switch the controls presentation style; used in the footer of the Button panel so a user who summoned a Hidden panel can switch back to the always-visible FAB.

members.name: ButtonVariant
members.about: Renders the floating panel and its triggers — a visually-hidden "Open preferences" skip-link (the keyboard/AT entry point, present in both styles) plus, in Button style, a draggable circular FAB; in Hidden style the skip-link is the only trigger and also anchors the panel. Moves focus into the panel on open and restores it on close. The open panel holds the palette picker, a collapsible Settings group, and a footer style-switcher; it computes available height and quadrant on open.

members.name: NavGroup
members.about: Persisted collapsible disclosure that lists the cross-page nav links inside the Button panel when the active layout is 'in-controls'; reuses the routing-aware NavAnchor from AppShell and persists its own open state (default open) so the nav stays reachable across visits.

members.name: SettingsGroup
members.about: Persisted collapsible disclosure that wraps the non-palette fields under a "Settings" heading; persists its own open state to localStorage so it re-opens in the same state on next visit.

members.name: CollapsibleSection
members.about: Accordion-style disclosure for a single non-palette field inside the Settings group — shows the current value in the collapsed header and expands to a Select combobox or a radio button group depending on option count.

files.about: Floating, freely draggable demo-controls overlay that renders either as a circular FAB (Button style) or as nothing at all (Hidden style, summoned by a tap gesture or the keyboard "Open preferences" skip-link); persists position and open state to localStorage, moves focus into the panel on open, and adapts layout to phone-sized viewports.

files.name: Drawer.tsx

members.name: DrawerVariant
members.about: Structural mode: 'side' is a plain panel, 'sectioned' adds a sticky footer with primary/secondary actions, 'navigable' manages a view-stack with breadcrumb and back button, 'sheet' slides up from the bottom with drag-to-snap and drag-to-dismiss.

members.name: DrawerSide
members.about: Which viewport edge the drawer slides in from; 'sheet' variant forces 'bottom' regardless of this prop.

members.name: DrawerSize
members.about: Panel width/height preset: 'sm' is narrow, 'md' is the default, 'lg' is wide; applied as a CSS modifier class on the dialog element.

members.name: DrawerView
members.about: A named screen for the 'navigable' variant: an id, title shown in the breadcrumb, and a render function that receives push/pop callbacks so its content can navigate deeper or back.

members.name: DrawerProps
members.about: Props for Drawer — variant and side define layout, open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange handle controlled or uncontrolled open state, views/initialViewId feed the navigable stack, snapPoints configure the sheet, and primaryAction/secondaryAction populate the sectioned footer.

members.name: Drawer
members.about: Renders a scrim-backed dialog panel portaled to the page root; handles focus trap on open, body scroll-lock, Escape key dismissal, and — in sheet mode — pointer-drag snap-point cycling.

files.about: Side-panel overlay component with four modes — plain slide-in, sectioned with footer action buttons, navigable with a push/pop view stack and breadcrumb, and a drag-snapping bottom sheet.

files.name: EcdfPlot.tsx

members.name: EcdfPlotVariant
members.about: Display mode: 'single' renders one ECDF step curve, 'multiple' overlays several series on a shared axis, 'percentiles' adds crosshair markers at p50/p90/p95/p99 for a single series.

members.name: EcdfIntent
members.about: Semantic colour applied to a series' step path and legend swatch; defaults to cycling through the intent palette by series index.

members.name: EcdfSeries
members.about: One named data series: an id, display label, raw unsorted numeric values array that will be sorted internally to produce the ECDF step curve, and optional intent colour.

members.name: EcdfPlotProps
members.about: Props for EcdfPlot — variant selects display mode, series supplies the raw value arrays, xDomain optionally clamps the x axis, and formatX formats x-axis tick labels.

members.name: PAD
members.about: SVG padding insets (px) — left accommodates y-axis percentage labels, bottom the x-axis value labels.

members.name: INTENTS
members.about: Default rotation through the six intent tokens applied to series when no per-series intent is provided.

members.name: HIGHLIGHT_P
members.about: The four percentile levels (p50/p90/p95/p99) annotated with crosshair markers in the 'percentiles' variant.

members.name: intentFor
members.about: Returns the intent for a series at index i — uses the explicit series.intent override if set, otherwise cycles through INTENTS.

members.name: quantile
members.about: Computes the p-th quantile of a pre-sorted array using linear interpolation between adjacent values; used to locate the crosshair positions at the HIGHLIGHT_P percentile levels.

members.name: defaultFormat
members.about: Default x-axis value formatter — locale-aware with 0 fraction digits for ≥1000, 1 for ≥10, 2 otherwise; used when no formatX prop is provided.

members.name: EcdfPlot
members.about: Renders an SVG ECDF chart by sorting each series' values and building a vertical-then-horizontal step path; the 'percentiles' variant overlays crosshair lines and dot markers at p50/p90/p95/p99.

files.about: SVG empirical cumulative distribution function chart that sorts raw values and draws a step-function curve from 0 to 100%; supports single, multi-series overlay, and percentile-annotated modes.

files.name: EdgeBundle.tsx

members.name: EdgeBundleVariant
members.about: Bundling mode: 'simple' draws straight lines (beta=0), 'bundled' pulls paths toward their LCA with beta=0.82 to bundle parallel edges, 'directional' uses beta=0.78 and colours each edge by the source node's intent.

members.name: EdgeBundleIntent
members.about: Semantic colour applied per leaf node and, in 'directional' mode, to its outgoing edges.

members.name: EdgeBundleNode
members.about: A hierarchy node with an id, display label, optional intent colour, and optional children; leaf nodes (no children) participate in edges and are placed on the outer radial ring.

members.name: EdgeBundleEdge
members.about: A connection between two leaf node ids with an optional numeric value shown in the SVG title tooltip.

members.name: EdgeBundleProps
members.about: Props for EdgeBundle — variant controls bundling strength and edge colouring; root is the hierarchy tree whose leaves will be placed on the ring; edges list the connections to draw between leaf ids.

members.name: INTENTS
members.about: Default rotation through the six intent tokens applied per top-level group of leaf siblings when no per-node intent is set.

members.name: Placed
members.about: Internal node descriptor after radial layout — stores the original node, its depth, angular span [a0, a1], pixel-space coordinates, leaf flag, resolved intent, parent reference, and placed children.

members.name: layoutRadial
members.about: Recursively visits the hierarchy tree and assigns each leaf an equal angular slot on the ring and each internal node the angular span of its subtree; computes pixel (x, y) from angle and depth-proportional radius.

members.name: ancestors
members.about: Walks the parent chain from node n up to the root, returning all ancestors in bottom-to-top order; used by bundlePath to find the LCA and build the control-point sequence.

members.name: bundlePath
members.about: Computes an SVG path string for a hierarchically bundled edge: walks from the source leaf up to the LCA then down to the target, pulls each control point toward the straight line by (1-beta), then renders the result as a Catmull-Rom-ish sequence of quadratic curves.

members.name: EdgeBundle
members.about: Renders a radial edge-bundling SVG: places leaf nodes evenly around a circle, then draws each edge as a Catmull-Rom-ish quadratic-spline path guided through the least-common-ancestor hierarchy nodes.

files.about: SVG hierarchical edge-bundling chart that arranges leaf nodes in a radial ring and routes edges through their least-common ancestor, producing smooth bundled curves that reveal community structure.

files.name: EmptyState.tsx

members.name: EmptyStateVariant
members.about: Presentation mode: 'minimal' shows only a title and optional description, 'illustrated' adds an illustration node and action buttons, 'checklist' lists onboarding steps with done markers and inline action buttons, 'generative' renders editable seed fields and a create button.

members.name: ChecklistStep
members.about: One onboarding step for the 'checklist' variant: an id, label, optional description, a done boolean for the checkmark, and an optional action button label/handler.

members.name: GenerativeField
members.about: An editable seed field for the 'generative' variant; the user can change its default value before calling onGenerate to create their first record.

members.name: EmptyStateProps
members.about: Props for EmptyState — variant selects the layout, title and description are always shown, illustration feeds the illustrated/generative modes, steps feeds the checklist, and fields/onGenerate feed the generative form.

members.name: EmptyState
members.about: Renders a centred empty-state block with role="status"; shows a title/description block in all modes, then conditionally renders the illustration, CTA buttons, checklist with step counter, or generative seed-field form depending on variant.

files.about: Zero-data placeholder supporting four formats — minimal text+icon, illustrated with primary/secondary CTAs, an onboarding checklist with progress, and a generative seed-field form that lets the user create their first record.

files.name: ForceCluster.tsx

members.name: ForceClusterVariant
members.about: Rendering style: 'hull' draws a smooth convex boundary around each cluster, 'shaded' fills those hulls with a translucent intent colour, 'labeled' additionally overlays the group name at each cluster's centroid.

members.name: ForceClusterIntent
members.about: Semantic colour assigned to a group and all its nodes; one intent per group, cycling through the palette by group discovery order.

members.name: ForceNode
members.about: A graph node with an id, display label, group key that determines cluster membership and intent colour, and optional numeric weight that scales the node's circle radius.

members.name: ForceEdge
members.about: A connection between two node ids with an optional numeric value that scales stroke width; intra-cluster and inter-cluster edges receive different CSS class modifiers.

members.name: ForceClusterProps
members.about: Props for ForceCluster — variant selects hull/shaded/labeled rendering; nodes carry group membership and optional weights; edges drive the force attraction used during layout relaxation.

members.name: INTENTS
members.about: Default rotation through the six intent tokens applied per group in discovery order.

members.name: Placed
members.about: A node after force-layout placement — carries the original ForceNode, final (x, y) pixel coordinates, circle radius scaled from the node's weight, its resolved intent, and its group key.

members.name: rng
members.about: Returns a deterministic pseudo-random number generator seeded from the given value; used to initialise node positions so the layout is identical on every render.

members.name: relax
members.about: Runs 80 iterations of force relaxation — places cluster centres on a ring, then applies all-pairs repulsion, per-cluster gravity, and edge attraction — returning a map of node id to final pixel position.

members.name: convexHull
members.about: Computes the convex hull of a point set using Andrew's monotone chain algorithm (O(n log n)); returns the minimal bounding polygon used as the base for cluster outlines.

members.name: inflateHull
members.about: Expands each hull vertex outward from the polygon centroid by `pad` pixels, producing a slightly larger "bubble" boundary that visually encloses the node circles.

members.name: smoothHull
members.about: Converts a convex hull polygon into a smooth closed SVG path by rendering midpoint-anchored quadratic Bézier curves between successive vertices, producing a rounded bubble outline.

members.name: ForceCluster
members.about: Renders a force-clustered network SVG: runs `relax` (80-iteration force simulation with all-pairs repulsion, cluster gravity, and edge attraction) then draws smooth inflated convex hulls behind edges and intent-coloured node circles.

files.about: SVG network graph that groups nodes by a string group key, runs a deterministic force-relaxation layout, and renders cluster convex-hull outlines in three modes — plain hull, shaded hull, and labelled clusters.

files.name: Funnel.tsx

members.name: FunnelVariant
members.about: Layout mode: 'stages' renders left-aligned proportional bars, 'dropoff' appends a secondary bar showing the absolute count lost versus the previous stage plus a step-conversion rate label, 'mirrored' centres each bar so the funnel narrows symmetrically.

members.name: FunnelIntent
members.about: Semantic colour applied to a stage's bar fill; defaults to cycling through the intent palette by stage index.

members.name: FunnelStage
members.about: A single funnel stage with a unique key, display label, numeric value (e.g. user count), and optional intent colour override.

members.name: FunnelProps
members.about: Props for Funnel — variant selects the layout, stages supplies the ordered data, showOverall controls whether the overall-conversion percentage appears beside each bar's value label.

members.name: INTENTS
members.about: Ordered palette of intent colours used to colour-cycle stages that have no explicit intent set.

members.name: intentFor
members.about: Returns the effective intent for a stage, using the stage's own intent if set, otherwise cycling through INTENTS by index.

members.name: defaultFormat
members.about: Formats a numeric value for display: uses locale thousands separators for values ≥ 1000, otherwise plain string conversion.

members.name: Funnel
members.about: Renders a horizontal bar funnel SVG where each stage's bar width is proportional to its value relative to the first stage; 'dropoff' appends a secondary drop bar and a step-conversion rate, 'mirrored' centres bars symmetrically.

files.about: SVG funnel/conversion chart with three layouts — plain stages with proportional bars, drop-off mode that appends a red loss bar to each stage, and a mirrored layout that centres bars horizontally.

files.name: Gauge.tsx

members.name: GaugeVariant
members.about: Display mode: 'arc' fills a single arc from min to value, 'zones' paints the track with coloured GaugeZone bands and colours the needle by the zone it falls in, 'full' renders a complete 360° ring instead of a 270° arc.

members.name: GaugeIntent
members.about: Semantic colour used for zone bands, the value arc, and the needle dot; in 'zones' mode the value's intent is inferred from which zone the current value falls into.

members.name: GaugeZone
members.about: A coloured segment of the 'zones' gauge track: a fraction of the total arc length (0–1, zones run low to high) and the intent colour to fill that segment.

members.name: GaugeProps
members.about: Props for Gauge — variant selects arc style, value/min/max define the range, zones configures the 'zones' colour bands, target draws an optional notch at a goal value, and caption is a short label shown under the centre value.

members.name: defaultFormat
members.about: Formats a gauge value for the centre label: locale thousands for large numbers, one decimal for ≥ 10, two decimals otherwise.

members.name: polar
members.about: Converts polar (radius, angle) to Cartesian (x, y) relative to a centre point — used for all arc endpoint calculations.

members.name: arcPath
members.about: Builds an SVG path string for a donut-arc segment between two angles, sweeping from rInner to rOuter — used for the track, value arc, and zone bands.

members.name: Gauge
members.about: Renders an arc-shaped gauge SVG with a grey track, an intent-coloured filled arc or zone bands, a small circle needle, an optional target line notch, and a centre value label with optional caption.

files.about: SVG arc gauge with three modes — plain arc fill, coloured zone bands with an intent-coloured needle, and a full-circle ring; supports an optional target notch and a centre value label.

files.name: Heatmap.tsx

members.name: HeatmapVariant
members.about: Colour scheme: 'continuous' maps absolute magnitude to five tint levels (l0–l4) in a single hue, 'diverging' uses separate pos/neg hues scaled from a configurable centre, 'sparse' applies tinting only at levels l3–l4 and suppresses labels on low-intensity cells.

members.name: HeatmapCell
members.about: A single cell value at a named row/column intersection; missing row×col combinations render as a 'missing' placeholder rect.

members.name: HeatmapProps
members.about: Props for Heatmap — variant selects the colour scheme, cells is the flat data array, rows/cols fix display order (default discovery order), cellSize sets the pixel dimension of each square, and center pins the midpoint for the 'diverging' scheme.

members.name: tintLevel
members.about: Maps a positive value to a tint level (0–4) relative to the dataset maximum, where 0 is blank and 4 is full intensity — used by the 'continuous' and 'sparse' variants.

members.name: divergingLevel
members.about: Maps a value to a signed tint level for the 'diverging' variant: returns the hue side ('pos'/'neg'/'zero') and a 0–4 intensity based on distance from the user-supplied center.

members.name: discoveryOrder
members.about: Returns unique strings in first-seen order from a list, used to derive the default row/column order from the flat cells array.

members.name: Heatmap
members.about: Renders an SVG grid where each cell is a rounded rect coloured by its tint level; 'continuous' and 'sparse' use `tintLevel` (absolute magnitude), 'diverging' uses `divergingLevel` (signed distance from center) with separate pos/neg CSS classes.

files.about: SVG grid heatmap that maps cell values to one of five tint levels in three colour schemes — continuous single-hue intensity, diverging positive/negative, and sparse (highlights only the top two intensity levels).

files.name: Hexbin.tsx

members.name: HexbinVariant
members.about: Encoding mode: 'density' uses tint level (l0–l4) to show relative count with fixed hex size, 'count' shows the raw count as a text label inside each hex, 'sized' scales each hex radius proportionally to the square root of its count.

members.name: HexbinPoint
members.about: A single data point in data-space coordinates; the component projects it into pixel space and snaps it to the nearest hex grid cell.

members.name: HexbinProps
members.about: Props for Hexbin — variant selects the count encoding, points is the raw (x,y) array, radius sets the hex circumradius in plot pixels, and xDomain/yDomain optionally clamp the data extents used for projection.

members.name: PAD
members.about: Pixel padding around the plot area: top/right/bottom/left margins that reserve space for axis tick labels.

members.name: defaultFormat
members.about: Formats axis tick values: locale thousands for ≥ 1000, one decimal for ≥ 10, two decimals otherwise.

members.name: hexPath
members.about: Returns an SVG path string for a pointy-top regular hexagon centred at (cx, cy) with circumradius r.

members.name: tintLevel
members.about: Maps a bin count to a discrete tint level (0–4) relative to the peak bin count, driving the CSS fill class on density and count hexes.

members.name: Hexbin
members.about: Renders a hexbin SVG by projecting each point through linear x/y scales then snapping to axial hex-grid coordinates; bins are tinted by count level, sized by sqrt(count), or labelled with raw counts depending on variant.

files.about: SVG hexagonal binning chart that aggregates 2D scatter points into a pointy-top hex grid and encodes per-bin count as tint intensity, hex size, or inline count labels depending on variant.

files.name: Histogram.tsx

members.name: HistogramVariant
members.about: Selects how bar heights are scaled: raw bin counts, probability density, or cumulative proportion (0–1).

members.name: HistogramProps
members.about: Props for Histogram — configures the data array, bin count, optional domain clamp, display size, and a custom number formatter.

members.name: PAD
members.about: Pixel padding around the plot area reserving space for y-axis tick labels on the left and x-axis tick labels on the bottom.

members.name: defaultFormat
members.about: Locale-aware number formatter for axis ticks and tooltip values: 0 decimals ≥ 1000, 1 decimal ≥ 10, 2 decimals otherwise.

members.name: Bin
members.about: Represents one histogram bucket with its left edge (x0), right edge (x1), and raw point count; produced by `binValues`.

members.name: binValues
members.about: Divides `values` into `binCount` equal-width buckets over the data range (or explicit `domain`), returning a Bin array with per-bucket counts.

members.name: Histogram
members.about: Renders a binned SVG histogram of a numeric array; bins data internally, draws y-axis gridlines and x-axis tick labels, and overlays vertical mean/median marker lines with a legend (hidden on the cumulative variant).

files.about: SVG histogram component that displays a numeric distribution as binned bars with mean/median markers, supporting counts, density, and cumulative views.

files.name: HiveDiagram.tsx

members.name: HiveDiagramVariant
members.about: Controls edge rendering: 'simple' uses uniform 1-px strokes, 'weighted' scales stroke width by edge value, 'directed' adds arrowhead markers.

members.name: HiveIntent
members.about: Semantic colour intent applied to nodes and axes; assignment follows axis discovery order when not set explicitly on a node.

members.name: HiveNode
members.about: A single node in the hive diagram: belongs to a named axis, carries a normalised [0, 1] position along that axis, and optionally overrides its colour intent.

members.name: HiveEdge
members.about: A directed connection between two node ids; an optional numeric value drives stroke width in the 'weighted' and 'directed' variants.

members.name: HiveDiagramProps
members.about: Props for HiveDiagram — supplies the node and edge arrays, optional canvas size, and the rendering variant.

members.name: INTENTS
members.about: Ordered intent palette used to assign a distinct colour to each axis and its nodes in discovery order.

members.name: AXIS_ANGLES_3
members.about: Fixed angles (in radians) for the three hive axes: pointing up, lower-right, and lower-left — evenly spaced 120° apart.

members.name: HiveDiagram
members.about: Renders nodes on three evenly-spaced radial axes (excess axes collapse onto axis 3), connects them with quadratic Bézier curves that bow away from the centre, and labels each axis at its far end; edge stroke widths and an arrowhead marker are activated by the 'weighted'/'directed' variants.

files.about: SVG hive diagram component that places nodes on three radial axes by a named axis attribute and connects them with curved edges, supporting simple, weighted, and directed variants.

files.name: Icicle.tsx

members.name: IcicleVariant
members.about: Sets the growth direction of the chart: 'down' fills from the root at the top, 'right' fans left-to-right, 'flame' flips so leaves are at the bottom.

members.name: IcicleIntent
members.about: Semantic colour intent cycling applied to top-level children; each subtree inherits its root child's colour.

members.name: IcicleNode
members.about: A recursive tree node; leaf size is driven by `value`, branch size is the sum of its children's values; `intent` overrides the inherited colour, `children` nests subtrees.

members.name: IcicleProps
members.about: Props for Icicle — accepts the tree root, layout variant, and optional canvas dimensions.

members.name: INTENTS
members.about: Ordered intent colour palette cycled over top-level children of the root; all descendant nodes inherit their subtree root's colour.

members.name: Block
members.about: Internal layout record for one rendered rectangle: its source node, nesting depth, pixel position (x, y, w, h), resolved intent colour, and depth-based tint level (1–4).

members.name: sumValue
members.about: Recursively sums a node's effective value — returns the node's own value for leaves and the total of all descendant leaf values for branches.

members.name: maxDepth
members.about: Returns the maximum nesting depth of any leaf in the subtree, used to compute layer thickness so the chart fills the canvas.

members.name: Icicle
members.about: Recursively partitions the tree into a flat list of screen-space blocks (via `visit`), then renders each as a `<rect>` labelled when wide/tall enough; the root block is always omitted so the chart shows only children.

files.about: SVG icicle/flame chart that recursively partitions a weighted tree into rectangular blocks, supporting top-down icicle, left-to-right, and bottom-up flame layouts.

files.name: IndentTree.tsx

members.name: IndentTreeVariant
members.about: 'plain' indents by blank spacers only; 'guides' adds box-drawing pipe/elbow/tee connectors; 'meta' additionally renders a right-aligned proportion bar and meta string.

members.name: IndentTreeIntent
members.about: Semantic colour intent applied per row; inherited from the parent node when not set on a child.

members.name: IndentTreeNode
members.about: A tree node with an optional right-aligned `meta` string, a numeric `weight` that drives the 'meta' variant's proportion bar, and nested `children` for deeper levels.

members.name: IndentTreeProps
members.about: Props for IndentTree — supplies the root node, display variant, and optional container width.

members.name: Row
members.about: Internal flat record for one rendered tree row: carries the source node, its nesting depth, whether it is its parent's last child (for elbow vs tee guide), an ancestor-last boolean list (for pipe vs blank column guides), its resolved intent, and effective weight.

members.name: INTENTS
members.about: Intent palette cycled over top-level children; each node's colour is inherited by its descendants unless overridden.

members.name: flatten
members.about: Performs a depth-first traversal of the tree, emitting one Row per node with its guide metadata (isLast, ancestorsLast), resolved intent, and aggregated weight.

members.name: maxWeight
members.about: Scans all rows for the maximum weight value, returning at least 1 so the 'meta' bar proportions are safe to compute.

members.name: IndentTree
members.about: Flattens the tree depth-first into a row array (tracking `isLast` and ancestor-last flags per level), then renders a `<ul role="tree">` where each `<li>` composes guide spans, a folder/leaf bullet, the label, and optionally a weight bar and meta string.

files.about: Accessible tree list component that renders a nested node hierarchy as indented rows, with optional box-drawing connector guides and a proportional weight bar in the 'meta' variant.

files.name: InlineEdit.tsx

members.name: InlineEditVariant
members.about: Selects the editing behaviour: 'click' commits on blur/Enter, 'validated' runs a validator before accepting, 'autosave' debounces and calls onSave automatically, 'history' adds a revert panel.

members.name: SaveStatus
members.about: Tracks the async save lifecycle shown as a status badge in the 'autosave' variant: idle while unchanged, dirty before the debounce fires, saving during the async call, then saved or error.

members.name: HistoryEntry
members.about: One entry in the edit history supplied to the 'history' variant: a Unix-ms timestamp and the value that was current at that point, displayed newest-first in the revert panel.

files.name: InteractionPlot.tsx

files.name: NLBar.tsx

files.name: NodeLink.tsx

members.name: NodeLinkVariant
members.about: Controls edge rendering: 'simple' uses uniform 1-px strokes, 'weighted' scales stroke width by edge value, 'directed' adds an SVG arrowhead marker at each edge target.

members.name: NodeLinkIntent
members.about: Semantic colour intent applied per node, derived from the node's `group` when no explicit `intent` is set; each distinct group receives the next intent in the rotation.

members.name: GraphNode
members.about: A node in the network: a stable `id`, a display `label` rendered below the circle, an optional `group` string for intent colouring and initial cluster placement, an optional `weight` that scales the circle radius, and optional explicit `x`/`y` in [0, 1] to override the force layout.

members.name: GraphEdge
members.about: A directed connection between two node ids; the optional `value` drives stroke width in the 'weighted'/'directed' variants and appears in the SVG `<title>` tooltip.

members.name: NodeLinkProps
members.about: Configures NodeLink — supplies the node and edge arrays, canvas dimensions, and the rendering variant.

members.name: INTENTS
members.about: Ordered intent cycle used to assign distinct colors to node groups when no explicit intent is set on a node; wraps modularly so any number of groups is handled.

members.name: Placed
members.about: Internal record produced by the layout pass: combines the original GraphNode with its computed canvas pixel position, circle radius, and resolved intent.

members.name: deterministicLayout
members.about: Places nodes on a canvas by clustering them on concentric arcs by group, then iterates 60 steps of Fruchterman-Reingold repulsion+spring attraction with linear cooling; returns a map from node id to pixel x/y.

members.name: NodeLink
members.about: Computes node positions via `deterministicLayout` (group-clustered initial placement followed by 60 iterations of Fruchterman-Reingold repulsion+attraction), then renders edges as straight lines and nodes as intent-coloured circles with text labels.

files.about: SVG node-link network diagram with a deterministic force-relaxation layout, supporting simple uniform edges, weighted stroke-width scaling, and directed arrowhead edges; node radius scales with the optional `weight` field.

files.name: OptimisticUndo.tsx
